flow.name: create-invoice-tool-flow
flow.doc:name: Tool: create_invoice
flow.doc:description: MCP tool flow that retrieves or generates an invoice for a given orderId

mcp:tool-listener.name: create_invoice
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: create_invoice
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Registers create_invoice tool; fires on tools/call for this tool name
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Retrieve or generate an invoice for an order. Returns the invoice ID, status, line items, subtotal, tax, and total amount for the specified order.

mcp:text-tool-response-content.text: #[write(vars.mcpError default {code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'An unexpected error occurred during invoice creation.'}, 'application/json')]

set-variable.doc:name: Extract orderId
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts and trims orderId from tool call input

choice.doc:name: Validate orderId
choice.doc:description: Rejects missing or empty orderId before querying mock data

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'orderId is required to create or retrieve an invoice.', orderId: vars.orderId}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Empty orderId Error
set-variable.doc:description: Builds INVALID_INPUT error when orderId is missing or empty

raise-error.doc:name: Raise INVALID_INPUT
raise-error.doc:description: Propagates error so mcp:on-error-responses returns the structured error

ee:transform.doc:name: Find Invoice
ee:transform.doc:description: Reads mock-invoices.json and returns the invoice matching the orderId, or null if not found

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var allInvoices = readUrl("classpath://mock-invoices.json", "application/json") var matches = allInvoices filter ($.orderId == vars.orderId) --- if (sizeOf(matches) > 0) matches[0] else null

choice.doc:name: Invoice Found?
choice.doc:description: Routes to success or raises INVOICE_NOT_FOUND

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'INVOICE_NOT_FOUND', message: 'No invoice exists for the supplied orderId. The order may not be eligible for invoicing.', orderId: vars.orderId}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Not Found Error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] create_invoice | orderId=' ++ (vars.orderId default '') ++ ' | invoiceId=' ++ (payload.invoiceId default '') ++ ' | total=' ++ ((payload.total default 0) as String)]
logger.doc:name: Log Success
logger.doc:description: Logs successful invoice retrieval with invoiceId and total

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle INVALID_INPUT
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates INVALID_INPUT so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] create_invoice | INVALID_INPUT - orderId is empty']
logger.doc:name: Log Invalid Input

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle INVOICE_NOT_FOUND
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates INVOICE_NOT_FOUND so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error

flow.name: get-payment-status-tool-flow
flow.doc:name: Tool: get_payment_status
flow.doc:description: MCP tool flow that returns payment status and details for a given orderId or paymentId

mcp:tool-listener.name: get_payment_status
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: get_payment_status
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Registers get_payment_status tool; fires on tools/call for this tool name
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Get the payment status and details for an order. Supply either orderId or paymentId — at least one is required. Returns payment method, transaction ID, amount, currency, and current status.

mcp:text-tool-response-content.text: #[write(vars.mcpError default {code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'An unexpected error occurred while retrieving payment status.'}, 'application/json')]

set-variable.doc:name: Extract orderId
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts optional orderId from tool call input

set-variable.doc:name: Extract paymentId
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts optional paymentId from tool call input

choice.doc:name: Validate Input
choice.doc:description: Ensures at least orderId or paymentId is supplied

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'Provide either orderId or paymentId to retrieve payment status.'}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Missing Input Error
set-variable.doc:description: Builds INVALID_INPUT error when neither orderId nor paymentId is supplied

raise-error.doc:name: Raise INVALID_INPUT
raise-error.doc:description: Propagates error so mcp:on-error-responses returns the structured error

ee:transform.doc:name: Find Payment
ee:transform.doc:description: Reads mock-payments.json, matches by orderId or paymentId, returns payment record or null

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var allPayments = readUrl("classpath://mock-payments.json", "application/json") var byOrderId = if (vars.lookupOrderId != '') allPayments filter ($.orderId == vars.lookupOrderId) else allPayments var byPaymentId = if (vars.lookupPaymentId != '') byOrderId filter ($.paymentId == vars.lookupPaymentId) else byOrderId --- if (sizeOf(byPaymentId) > 0) byPaymentId[0] else null

choice.doc:name: Payment Found?
choice.doc:description: Routes to success or raises PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND', message: 'No payment record was found for the supplied orderId or paymentId.', orderId: (vars.lookupOrderId default ''), paymentId: (vars.lookupPaymentId default '')}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Not Found Error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] get_payment_status | paymentId=' ++ (payload.paymentId default '') ++ ' | status=' ++ (payload.paymentStatus default '') ++ ' | amount=' ++ ((payload.amount default 0) as String)]
logger.doc:name: Log Success
logger.doc:description: Logs successful payment status lookup with paymentId, status, and amount

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle INVALID_INPUT
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates INVALID_INPUT so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] get_payment_status | INVALID_INPUT - no orderId or paymentId supplied']
logger.doc:name: Log Invalid Input

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] get_payment_status | PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND | orderId=' ++ (vars.lookupOrderId default '') ++ ' | paymentId=' ++ (vars.lookupPaymentId default '')]
logger.doc:name: Log Not Found

flow.name: process-refund-tool-flow
flow.doc:name: Tool: process_refund
flow.doc:description: MCP tool flow that processes or retrieves a refund for a given orderId

mcp:tool-listener.name: process_refund
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: process_refund
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Registers process_refund tool; fires on tools/call for this tool name
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Process a refund request for an order or retrieve an existing refund record. Provide the orderId and an optional reason. Returns refund ID, status, amount, and timestamps.

mcp:text-tool-response-content.text: #[write(vars.mcpError default {code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'An unexpected error occurred while processing the refund.'}, 'application/json')]

set-variable.doc:name: Extract orderId
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts and trims orderId from tool call input

set-variable.doc:name: Extract reason
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts optional refund reason; defaults to generic reason if not supplied

set-variable.doc:name: Extract amount
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts optional refund amount; null means full refund

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'orderId is required to process a refund.'}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Empty orderId Error
set-variable.doc:description: Builds INVALID_INPUT error when orderId is missing or empty

raise-error.doc:name: Raise INVALID_INPUT
raise-error.doc:description: Propagates error so mcp:on-error-responses returns the structured error

ee:transform.doc:name: Find or Simulate Refund
ee:transform.doc:description: Looks up existing refund in mock-refunds.json; if none found, cross-checks order and simulates an INITIATED refund

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/java var allRefunds = readUrl("classpath://mock-refunds.json", "application/json") var allOrders = readUrl("classpath://mock-orders.json", "application/json") var refundMatch = allRefunds filter ($.orderId == vars.orderId) var orderMatch = allOrders filter ($.orderId == vars.orderId) var order = if (sizeOf(orderMatch) > 0) orderMatch[0] else null var existingRef = if (sizeOf(refundMatch) > 0) refundMatch[0] else null
// Determine effective refund amount (input or full order total) var effectiveAmount = if (vars.refundAmount != null) vars.refundAmount else if (order != null) order.orderTotal else 0.00 --- if (order == null) null // order does not exist — caller will raise NOT_FOUND else if (existingRef != null) existingRef // return the existing refund record else { // simulate a new INITIATED refund refundId: "REF-MOCK-" ++ vars.orderId, orderId: vars.orderId, paymentId: order.paymentId, customerId: order.customerId, refundAmount: effectiveAmount, currency: "USD", reason: vars.refundReason, status: "INITIATED", requestedAt: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, processedAt: null }

choice.doc:name: Refund Resolved?
choice.doc:description: Routes to success or raises ORDER_NOT_FOUND when the order does not exist

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND', message: 'No order was found for the supplied orderId. Cannot process refund.', orderId: vars.orderId}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Order Not Found Error
set-variable.doc:description: Builds ORDER_NOT_FOUND error payload when the order does not exist

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] process_refund | orderId=' ++ (vars.orderId default '') ++ ' | refundId=' ++ (payload.refundId default '') ++ ' | status=' ++ (payload.status default '')]
logger.doc:name: Log Success
logger.doc:description: Logs successful refund processing with refundId, orderId, and status

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle INVALID_INPUT
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates INVALID_INPUT so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] process_refund | INVALID_INPUT - orderId is empty']
logger.doc:name: Log Invalid Input

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle ORDER_NOT_FOUND
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates ORDER_NOT_FOUND so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error
